visual_rule: Every voiced beat owns one unique full-screen composition whose children visibly perform the narrated actions; no story artwork is reused.
text_panel_policy: No instructional cards during the story; only a short opening title and final end card are allowed.

shots.line: In a sunny craft club, Amara, Ben, and Kai found one big cardboard box. They drew, decorated, and opened every flap together.
shots.visual: The three children actively draw a wheel, hold a paper decoration, and open a top flap around the original box.
shots.motion: Slow push-in, drifting paper shapes, and gentle character-focused camera travel.

shots.line: First, their box became a bus! Turn your pretend wheel, point to the next stop, then ring the paper bell. Ding, ding!
shots.visual: The same children steer, point, ring, and wave from the cardboard bus while imaginary scenery travels past.
shots.motion: Horizontal tracking, wheel pulse, road dashes, and a gentle bus bounce.

shots.line: Next, wide flaps made a cozy cave. A paper lantern glowed, painted spirals appeared, and a soft waterfall lifted. Wiggle your explorer fingers.
shots.visual: The children crawl, point, light, and lift fabric inside a magical but clearly pretend cardboard cave.
shots.motion: Lantern glow pulse, waterfall shimmer, floating light specks, and a slow cave pan.

shots.line: Then the cave became a puppet theatre. A smiling sun rose, a friendly frog hopped, and Kai opened the curtain. Can your hands hop, shine, and clap for the show?
shots.visual: The children operate original sun and frog puppets, open the curtain, and applaud around the theatre box.
shots.motion: Curtain sway, puppet bounce, warm stage-light sweep, and rhythmic clap sparkles.

shots.line: At blue-hour, the theatre grew quiet. Cushions, a little roof, and picture books made a reading nook. Turn one pretend page, then make a gentle welcome wave.
shots.visual: The children turn pages, follow pictures, add a cushion, and welcome one another into the cozy reading nook.
shots.motion: Slow camera push, lantern breathing glow, paper-star twinkle, and drifting twilight dust.

shots.line: One box became four wonderful worlds: a bus, a cave, a theatre, and a reading nook. The friends bowed, waved, and cheered, because imagination grows when we build together!
shots.visual: All four inventions surround the active children as they steer, raise a puppet, carry a book, bow, wave, and celebrate.
shots.motion: Celebration camera arc, floating paper confetti, gentle prop pulses, and an ensemble bow.
